gloss: as one wishes; at one's will; freely

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; at one's will; at one's pleasure
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly as one wants, having full control over a situation or being able to act without restriction.

examples.english: He manipulates people as he pleases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Nature doesn't bend to human will.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支配|しはい}しよう→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧とした。
examples.english: The ruler tried to control the country as he saw fit.

notes:
Combines ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (intention, will) with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (as is, unchanged). Expresses having complete control or freedom to do as one wishes. Often used when describing someone exerting power or influence over others or situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧: to manipulate at will
- {意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do as one pleases with
- {意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to not go as one wishes
- {意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move as one wills

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly literary or dramatic tone. Common in narratives about power, control, and freedom. The negative form {意|い}のまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ is very common, expressing frustration that things aren't going as planned.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}いのまま→思いのまま：22133_omoinomama⟧: as one feels/desires — similar but slightly more emotional
- ⟦{思|おも}い{通|どお}り→思い通り：25845_omoidoori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as one expects — focuses on things matching expectations
- ⟦{自由自在|じゆうじざい}→自由自在：21838_jiyuujizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: freely, at will — emphasizes skillful control
- ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: however one likes — more casual
